reader_summary.headline: Travis Kalanick returns to build industrial AI for food, mining, and logistics.
reader_summary.overview: Former Uber CEO Travis Kalanick discusses his past fundraising struggles and his new company, Atoms. He plans to use industrial AI to automate physical industries like food delivery and mining. His goal is to lower costs and improve safety while relearning manufacturing skills.
